claims.claim: Quintus Septimius Florens Tertullianus was a Carthaginian Christian writer born around 155‑160 AD and died after 220 AD.
In the opening of De patientia Tertullian confesses his own lack of patience and says he writes the work to exhort fellow Christians to practice the virtue.
Critical editions of the Latin text include the CSEL edition (1906) and the CCSL edition (1954).
Tertullian is regarded as the father of Latin Christianity and a formative figure in the development of Western Christian thought.
